area.description: ID of the area containing the DC bus.

available.description: Whether the component is online (true) or offline (false). Unavailable components are excluded from simulations.

base_voltage.description: The base voltage. in psy5 a required param with an option to be nothing Units: kV.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

load_zone.description: ID of the load zone containing the DC bus.

magnitude.description: Voltage as a multiple of `base_voltage`. in psy5 a required param with an option to be nothing Units: pu.

name.description: Name of the component. Unique among components of the same type; components of different types may share a name.

number.description: A unique bus identification number (positive integer).

voltage_limits.description: Limits on the voltage variation as multiples of `base_voltage`. in psy5 a required param with an option to be nothing Units: pu.
